name: Antioch
overview: Antioch is significant in Scripture as a key center for early Christian ministry and mission. The church in Antioch of Syria, where disciples were first called Christians, included prominent leaders like Barnabas and Saul (Paul), who were active in teaching and sending out missionaries (Acts 11:19; 13:1). Additionally, Antioch of Pisidia is noted as a place where Paul boldly preached in the synagogue, addressing both Jews and God-fearing Gentiles with exhortation grounded in Israel’s history and God’s deliverance (Acts 13:14-17). These accounts highlight Antioch’s pivotal role in the spreading of the gospel and the establishment of the early church.
